# Data sources

From `config/sources.yaml` (plan 10 §13). T1 = exchange, regulator or the company's own filing; T2 = reputable aggregator; T3 = convenience or LLM-derived. When sources disagree, the higher tier wins.

| ID | Tier | Data | Access | Terms | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amfi` | T1 | cap_classification | HTTPS semi-annual list (amfiindia.com) | public regulatory disclosure | semi-annual (January, July) |
| `bse` | T1 | prices_unadjusted, filings, announcements, concall_transcripts | HTTPS (bseindia.com bhavcopy and filings) | BSE website terms; personal, non-commercial research; throttled, cached | daily |
| `cas_depository` | T1 | holdings_quantity | NSDL/CDSL CAS PDF, parsed locally with casparser; never uploaded (P6) | your own statement | monthly |
| `niftyindices` | T1 | index_constituents | HTTPS constituent CSVs (niftyindices.com) | NSE Indices website terms; personal research | monthly |
| `nse_archives` | T1 | prices_unadjusted, corporate_actions, financial_results_xbrl, shareholding_pattern, announcements, holidays | HTTPS (nsearchives.nseindia.com, www.nseindia.com/api), reachable from GitHub runners (spike ②) | NSE website terms; personal, non-commercial research; throttled, cached, never redistributed | daily |
| `groww_pnl` | T2 | holdings_cost | manual Groww "Stocks P&L Report" export, parsed locally | your own statement | one-time seed, then on demand |
| `screener_concalls` | T2 | concall_index | HTTPS company page Concalls list, linking BSE-filed PDFs (D7) | Screener website terms; personal research; throttled | quarterly |
| `screener_export` | T2 | fundamentals | manual Excel export ("Data Sheet" v2.1) from your Screener account, placed in FILES FOR ANALYSIS | personal use under your Screener account; exports are not committed or redistributed | quarterly, after results |
| `yfinance` | T2 | prices_adjusted | yfinance (Yahoo Finance, unofficial API), TICKER.NS | Yahoo terms; personal research; cross-checked against the exchange close | daily |
